title: ARCADE: THE CONTROLS CARD
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 19 of 20. A walk-up player has never seen the game. Every arcade drop now puts a big controls card at the left of the screen while the spawn shield is up and for 4 seconds after it drops: MOVE, AIM, FIRE, ROLL, RELOAD, SWITCH GUN, HEAL and EXTRACT, each with its keyboard key and its controller button. The keys follow CHANGE KEYS and a PlayStation pad reads its own buttons. The HOW TO PLAY page of the demo loop shows the same 8 rows. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade a big controls card with keyboard and controller buttons sits at the left at every drop while the shield is up and for 4 seconds after, and the HOW TO PLAY page shows the same 8 rows.
